In class, kids practice:

Skills kids build on the mats

01 · Reset Calmly

Students learn to breathe, listen, and reset when a drill gets difficult rather than panicking or quitting.

02 · Solve Real Problems

Safe falling, escapes, positional control, and live grappling games with a thoughtfully matched partner.

03 · Earned Confidence

Confidence earned from practice. Knowing they can protect themselves, keep trying, and work through tricky situations with a partner.

Reserve Free Intro
Your child’s first visit

What to expect at the Free Intro

Trying a martial arts studio can feel unfamiliar. Your child's first visit is calm, structured, and entirely non-competitive.

Step 1

Room Tour & Arrival

Arrive in clean athletic clothing. Coach Sandy welcomes your family, walks you through the room, and lets your child explore the mats with zero pressure.

Step 2

Safety & Boundary Talk

We explain clear boundaries, how tapping works, and match your child with a gentle, thoughtfully matched partner who helps them feel comfortable.

Step 3

Paced Movement Practice

Kids try basic games, safe falling, and balance drills at their own pace. Parents are welcome to sit matside and watch the entire session.

What happens in class

Coached movement and partner practice

Kids learn movement, position, safe falling, and control through age-appropriate activities. Sandy adjusts the pace and challenge so students can learn safely.

See How Class Works

ONE FAMILY · ONE TRAINING GROUND

Your kid doesn't have to be the only one getting stronger.

Adult beginner classes meet right after youth training at 6:00 PM. You don't have to get in shape first; training is how you get in shape. Drop them off at 5:00 PM, jump on the mats at 6:00 PM, and share a common active routine at home.

All 12-week youth enrollments include our 30-Day Training Fit Guarantee.
